lines.en: label saraspring6:
scene sarabarpostyuki1
: {i}Hah...{/i}poor Yuki. She’s still so young. I can’t even imagine dealing with something that serious at her age.
lines.zh: : {i}哈{/i}……可怜的 Yuki。她还那么年轻。我甚至想象不出在她那个年纪要面对那么严重的事。

lines.en: : Didn’t you hate her only a couple hours ago?
lines.zh: : 你不是几个小时前还恨她吗？

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki2
: I didn’t {i}hate{/i} her! I was just very mad at her for erasing all of the progress she’s made for seemingly no reason other than “just because!”
lines.zh: : 我没有{i}恨{/i}她！我只是很生她的气，因为她把好不容易攒下的进步全抹掉了，看上去还毫无理由，就只是「因为」！

lines.en: : It’s totally different now that I know there {i}was{/i} a “because!” I’m allowed to forgive her if I want! I’m an adult!
lines.zh: : 现在我知道{i}有{/i}个「原因」了，那就完全不一样了！我想原谅她就可以原谅！我是成年人！

lines.en: : I didn’t say you weren’t...I just think it’s funny how quickly things can change sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我又没说你不是……我只是觉得有时候事情变化得这么快，挺好笑的。

lines.en: : I’m glad she’s coming back as well. Even if it means getting fewer hours...
lines.zh: : 她要回来我也挺高兴的。哪怕这意味着我的工时会变少……

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki3
: I’m sure you don’t mind the “fewer hours” part at all since you’re so into {i}bamboo{/i} all of a sudden. This just makes more time for your {i}hobbies.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我敢说你根本不在乎「工时变少」这一部分，谁让你突然对{i}竹子{/i}这么上心。这下你的{i}爱好{/i}有更多时间了。

lines.en: : You had the same hobbies as me when you were my age...
lines.zh: : 你在我这个年纪的时候，爱好也跟我一样啊……

lines.en: : Maybe so...but I still wish you wouldn’t do things like...{i}whatever you were doing{/i} in the middle of the bar. What if a customer walked in?
lines.zh: : 也许是吧……可我还是希望你别在……别在酒吧正中间{i}干那种事{/i}。要是有客人进来怎么办？

lines.en: : Are you really trying to say you’ve never {i}done anything{/i} in the bar before?
lines.zh: : 你真想说你从没在酒吧里{i}做过什么{/i}吗？

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki4
if saraspring2 == True:
: Of course not! I-
lines.zh: : 当然没有！我——

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki5
: Mm! Mm! Mm! [saramaster]! Mmm!
lines.zh: : 嗯！嗯！嗯！[saramaster]！嗯嗯！

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki6
scene sarabarpostyuki7
: Shut up.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。

lines.en: : I didn’t even say anything...
lines.zh: : 我还没说话呢……

lines.en: : No, but you wanted to and I decided to beat you to the punch.
lines.zh: : 是没说，但你想说，而我决定先发制人。

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki8
else:
: Of course not! At least...not that I can remember!
lines.zh: : 当然没有！至少……我记得是没有！

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki8
: Honestly, I don’t think I really {i}needed{/i} to say anything in the first place...I think us doing things like this is just sort of...expected, in a sense...
lines.zh: : 说实话，我觉得我一开始根本没什么{i}好说的{/i}……我觉得我们做这种事，在某种意义上就是……迟早的事……

lines.en: : For me, maybe. But for my teenage daughter? I don’t think so.
lines.zh: : 对我是。但对我那个十几岁的女儿？我可不这么想。

lines.en: : Well, forgive me for keeping myself occupied while you were upstairs probably crying. And if it makes you feel any better, I was the one who started it.
lines.zh: : 那抱歉了，你在楼上大概是哭的时候，我总得给自己找点事做。要是这能让你好受点的话，是我先开始的。

lines.en: : Of course you were. That does not surprise me at all given what I have learned about you lately. Also, I’ll have you know I only cried a {i}little.{/i} And that’s just because I love Yuki.
lines.zh: : 当然是你。以我最近对你的了解，这一点也不让我意外。还有，我告诉你，我只哭了{i}一点点{/i}。而且那只是因为我爱 Yuki。

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki9
: I know you do...which is why I’m glad she’s coming back. Having her around should probably help cut back on the stress, right? Can we even afford to pay her, though?
lines.zh: : 我知道你爱她……所以我才高兴她要回来。有她在，应该能帮你减轻点压力，对吧？不过我们还付得起她工资吗？

lines.en: : I commanded her to work for free to make up for all of the absences.
lines.zh: : 我命令她免费干活，好补偿她旷的那些班。

lines.en: : I don’t think that’s legal.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这可不合法。

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki10
: Since when do you care about the law?!
lines.zh: : 你什么时候开始在乎法律了？！

lines.en: : I never said I objected. Just...making an observation. It only makes sense you’d take advantage of someone {i}else’s{/i} labor when you’ve shown me firsthand how little you care about labor laws.
lines.zh: : 我又没说反对。只是……随口一说。既然你已经亲手向我展示了你有多不在乎劳动法，你会去占{i}别人{/i}劳动的便宜也合情合理。

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki11
: Just be happy I’m not making you work at a porn shop like Maki’s daughter is. I can only imagine what {i}that{/i} would do for this...sexual awakening of yours.
lines.zh: : 你就庆幸我没让你去 Maki 女儿那种色情用品店打工吧。我都不敢想{i}那{/i}会对你这次的……性觉醒造成什么影响。

lines.en: : Nothing the Internet hasn’t already done, probably.
lines.zh: : 大概互联网早就做过了。

lines.en: : Sana, what am I even supposed to say to that?
lines.zh: : Sana，你让我怎么接这话？

lines.en: : I don’t know. You’re the one who brought up sexual awakenings and porn. I’m just trying to have a conversation with my mom here.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。是你先提起性觉醒和色情的。我只是想跟我妈聊聊天。

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki12
: Oh, good. Then why don’t you tell me about your day at school instead?
lines.zh: : 哦，好啊。那你不如跟我讲讲你在学校的一天？

lines.en: : Sure. I got really turned on during gym class and had to go to the bathroom to touch myself.
lines.zh: : 好啊。上体育课的时候我特别来感觉，只好去厕所自己摸了摸。

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki13
: That’s not what I meant!
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思！

lines.en: : Hey, you asked. How was {i}your{/i} day then?
lines.zh: : 嘿，是你问的。那{i}你{/i}今天过得怎么样？

lines.en: : Fine, thank you! See how easy that was?!
lines.zh: : 挺好的，谢谢！你看这多简单？！

lines.en: : Easy, sure. But that doesn’t mean it’s exciting.
lines.zh: : 简单是简单。可简单不代表有意思。

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki14
: Not everything has to be {i}exciting,{/i} Sana. In fact, a huge part of growing up and understanding these {i}changes{/i} you’re going through is learning how to suppress or control them.
lines.zh: : 不是非得每件事都{i}有意思{/i}，Sana。事实上，长大、理解你正在经历的这些{i}变化{/i}，很大一部分就是学会怎么压抑或控制它们。

lines.en: : The whole world would be one giant, lawless orgy if everyone just submitted to their first sign of arousal. Is that really the world you want to-
lines.zh: : 要是每个人都对自己第一丝性冲动俯首称臣，那整个世界就会变成一场无法无天的巨型狂欢。那真的是你想要的世——

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki15
: Are you going to finish your question?
lines.zh: : 你要把问题问完吗？

lines.en: : No, because I already know how you’d answer and it would only make me sad.
lines.zh: : 不了，因为我已经知道你会怎么答，那只会让我难过。

lines.en: : I think I get what you’re saying. Like, even Sensei didn’t really want to do anything with me today. He just wanted to sit there and talk.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我懂你的意思。就像 Sensei 今天其实也不想跟我做什么。他只是想坐着聊聊天。

lines.en: : Because not {i}everything{/i} revolves around sex. Sometimes, people just want to be together. Like me and you. Or...me and Yuki.
lines.zh: : 因为不是{i}所有事{/i}都围着性转。有时候，人们只是想待在一起。就像我和你。或者……我和 Yuki。

lines.en: : {i}We{/i} didn’t have sex when we were upstairs talking. It didn’t even occur to us.
lines.zh: : {i}我们{/i}在楼上聊天的时候就没做爱。我们连想都没想过。

lines.en: : But you would totally have sex with Yuki if she was gay.
lines.zh: : 可如果 Yuki 是个同性恋，你肯定会跟她做。

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki16
: Not immediately after finding out she has cancer! There’s a time and a place for that stuff, and if all you do every time you’re feeling it is {i}act{/i} on it, it’ll stop being enjoyable at all.
lines.zh: : 不会是在刚知道她得了癌症之后！那种事得挑时间挑地方，要是你每次一有感觉就{i}行动{/i}，那它迟早会变得一点都不享受。

lines.en: : When? Because that’s what Sensei’s been doing his whole life and he still seems to be enjoying it a lot.
lines.zh: : 什么时候会？Sensei 一辈子都在这么干，他看起来还是享受得很。

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki17
: That’s because Sensei is a boy and boys are broken. The end.
lines.zh: : 那是因为 Sensei 是个男的，而男的都是坏的。说完了。

lines.en: : That just sounds like a convenient excuse to try and teach me a lesson while giving him the benefit of the doubt.
lines.zh: : 这听起来就像是个顺手编的借口，好一边教训我，一边给他开脱。

lines.en: : Well, that’s probably because it is. Now, tell me how your day at school went without any details about masturbation, please.
lines.zh: : 嗯，大概因为它本来就是。那么，请你讲讲你在学校的一天，别带任何自慰的细节。

lines.en: : I brought up the threesome to Sensei while you guys were upstairs.
lines.zh: : 你们在楼上那会儿，我跟 Sensei 提了3P的事。

lines.en: : That doesn’t sound like school at all. Also, what threesome?
lines.zh: : 这跟学校八竿子打不着啊。还有，什么3P？

lines.en: : The one with you and me. That we talked about at the bathhouse?
lines.zh: : 就是你和我啊。我们在澡堂聊过的那个？

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki18
: You brought that up to {i}him?!{/i} Sana!
lines.zh: : 你跟{i}他{/i}提那个了？！Sana！

lines.en: : That’s why he got so hard that he had to look away from you guys. He was probably thinking about us touching each other.
lines.zh: : 所以他那会儿才硬成那样，不得不把视线从你们身上移开。他大概是在想我们互相摸来摸去。

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki19
: Oh my God.
lines.zh: : 哦，天哪。

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki20
: I think I need to go lie down.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我得去躺一会儿。

lines.en: : Where are you going? Things were just getting good.
lines.zh: : 你去哪儿？好戏才刚开始呢。

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki21
: We clearly have different definitions of “good” then, because {i}mine{/i} does not involve having sex with my daughter.
lines.zh: : 那我们对「好戏」的定义显然不一样，因为{i}我的{/i}定义里不包括和我女儿做爱。

lines.en: : But it {i}could{/i} if you stopped making such a big deal out of this. Just give it a try. The worst that could happen is you don’t like it and we don’t do it again.
lines.zh: : 可要是你别把这事闹得这么大，那就{i}包括了{/i}呀。试一次嘛。最坏的结果无非是你不喜欢，然后我们以后不再做。

lines.en: : No, the worst that could happen is that it scars you for life and ruins our relationship forever. And that’s something I refuse to jeopardize, Sana. I can’t lose you too.
lines.zh: : 不，最坏的结果是你留下一辈子的心理阴影，我们母女的关系也永远毁了。那是我绝不肯拿去冒险的东西，Sana。我不能再失去你了。

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki22
: I thought I already mentioned this will bring us closer together, though.
lines.zh: : 我记得我说过，这会让我们的关系更亲密。

lines.en: : You’ve mentioned a lot of things and I remember virtually none of them because this is so insane to me that I’ve been in a perpetual state of shock since watching you get railed on DVD.
lines.zh: : 你说过的事多了，我基本一件都不记得，因为这一切对我来说太疯狂了，自从在光碟上看你被人猛操那天起，我就一直处在持续的震惊里。

lines.en: : That wasn’t a DVD. It was live.
lines.zh: : 那不是光碟。是直播。

lines.en: : {i}Whatever{/i} it was! That’s not how I’m supposed to see my little girl!
lines.zh: : {i}管它是什么{/i}！我不该是那样看到自己小女儿的！

lines.en: : I used to give you baths in a sink! I’d do the...what do they call it? The...the airplane thing! When you wouldn’t eat your food! Whoosh! Like that! Now I’m supposed to have a threesome with you?!
lines.zh: : 我以前是在洗手池里给你洗澡的！我还做过……那叫什么来着？那个……小飞机！你不吃饭的时候！咻——！就像那样！现在我却要跟你玩3P？！

lines.en: : Well, of course it’s weird if you still see me as a baby. But I’m not like that anymore. I’m the same age you were when {i}you{/i} were having unprotected sex with your teacher.
lines.zh: : 当然啦，你要是还把我当小宝宝看，那确实奇怪。可我不再是那样了。我现在正是{i}你{/i}当年跟老师无套做爱时的年纪。

lines.en: : And I think that me wanting to {i}share{/i} that with you just shows you how good our relationship {i}is{/i} when you never would have done that with Grandma.
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得，我想跟你{i}分享{/i}这件事，恰恰说明了我们的关系有多{i}好{/i}——换成奶奶，你绝不会这么做。

lines.en: : It’s disgusting, Sana.
lines.zh: : 这很恶心，Sana。

lines.en: : You think I’m disgusting?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我恶心？

lines.en: : What? No, I...{i}hah...{/i}
: I don’t think {i}you’re{/i} disgusting. I think you’re beautiful. If I thought you were disgusting, I wouldn’t be trying to make this happen in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得{i}你{/i}恶心。我觉得你很美。我要是觉得你恶心，一开始就不会想促成这件事了。

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki23
: And Sensei...what did {i}he{/i} have to say about this?
lines.zh: : 那 Sensei……{i}他{/i}对此说了什么？

lines.en: : Mostly stuff like, “Sara would never” and “How could you do that to your mom?”
lines.zh: : 大多是「Sara 绝不会」和「你怎么能这样对你妈」之类的话。

lines.en: : And you just kept going and asking for it anyway?
lines.zh: : 然后你就一路继续追问他？

lines.en: : Yeah, because he doesn’t get it. We’re not a normal mother-daughter combination. We’re different from if Makoto and her mom did something like this.
lines.zh: : 是啊，因为他不懂。我们不是普通的母女组合。我们跟 Makoto 和她妈做这种事不一样。

lines.en: : Why? How? What makes us different? Why can’t we be a normal mother-daughter combination like Maki and her kid?
lines.zh: : 为什么？怎么不一样？是什么让我们不一样？为什么我们就不能像 Maki 和她孩子那样，做一对普通的母女？

lines.en: : I mean...I guess we {i}can.{/i} I just figured we love each other a little more than that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概也{i}能{/i}吧。我只是觉得我们爱彼此比她们多一点。

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki24
: What?...
: I mean, I know I love {i}you{/i} more than Makoto loves her mom. More than Rin loves hers too.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我知道我有多爱{i}你{/i}，比 Makoto 爱她妈多，也比 Rin 爱她妈多。

lines.en: : I love you more than any of the girls I know love their parents apart from, like...Ami and Sensei. But they’re a whole other story.
lines.zh: : 我认识的女孩里，除了……Ami 和 Sensei 之外，没有谁比我爱父母更多。不过他们是另一回事。

lines.en: : I just don’t understand how any of this leads to experiencing {i}sex{/i} together, though. You’ve always tried to keep me {i}out{/i} of your life. You don’t even like when I hang out with you and Ayane.
lines.zh: : 可我还是不理解，这些怎么会导向一起体验{i}性{/i}这件事。你一直把我从你的生活里{i}推开{/i}。我跟你和 Ayane 一起玩你都不乐意。

lines.en: : So how did any of that lead to this? How is {i}this{/i} the thing you think will-
lines.zh: : 那这一切怎么会走到这一步？你怎么会觉得{i}这件事{/i}就能——

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki25
: It’s your job to provide for me, is it not?
lines.zh: : 你的职责就是养我，不是吗？

lines.en: : It is...And I know I haven’t provided enough. But I’ve been trying, Sana. I’ve been trying forever. And going through with this isn’t going to provide {i}anything{/i} long-term. It’s just...a fantasy. That’s it.
lines.zh: : 是……我知道我养得不够。可我一直在努力，Sana。我努力了太久太久了。而把这事儿做了，并不能带来{i}任何{/i}长远的东西。它只是……一场幻想。仅此而已。

lines.en: : That’s just pessimism.
lines.zh: : 那只是悲观。

lines.en: : I think this is the first step to starting over. And I think that if either of us are ever going to end up with him, this is something that needs to happen.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这是重新开始的第一步。而且我觉得，如果我们俩有谁最终要和他在一起，这件事就非发生不可。

lines.en: : But more than that, it’s something I {i}want{/i} to happen. And I want it because I love you and I want to share that love with you.
lines.zh: : 但更重要的是，这是我{i}希望{/i}发生的事。我希望它发生，是因为我爱你，我想把这份爱跟你分享。

lines.en: : It’s not {i}weird{/i} at all and you know it. You’re only saying that because you think you’re {i}supposed{/i} to say that. Because you think {i}not{/i} doing things like this makes you a good mom.
lines.zh: : 这一点也不{i}奇怪{/i}，你自己心里清楚。你这么说，只是因为你觉得自己{i}该{/i}这么说。因为你觉得{i}不做{/i}这种事才让你是个好妈妈。

lines.en: scene sarabarpostyuki26
: But deep down, you know you want it too.
lines.zh: : 可你内心深处，知道自己也想。

lines.en: : You know there’s something in our blood that makes us this way. A voice in your head, maybe. A whisper, telling you to {i}do it. Do it. Do it.{/i} Driving you {i}crazy{/i} if you don’t.
lines.zh: : 你知道我们血液里有某种东西让我们变成这样。也许是脑子里有个声音。一句低语，叫你{i}去做。去做。去做{/i}。你要是不做，它就快把你{i}逼疯{/i}。

lines.en: : Maybe that’s just me, though. And maybe I {i}am{/i} crazy for believing in the truths I think will lead us to a happy ending.
lines.zh: : 不过也许只有我这样。也许我{i}疯了{/i}，才会相信那些我以为能带我们走向圆满结局的真相。

lines.en: : Do you think I’m crazy, Mom?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我疯了吗，妈？

lines.en: : I don’t think you’re crazy, baby...I just think you have a...strange fetish that you...don’t entirely {i}understand{/i} yet.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得你疯了，宝贝……我只是觉得你有种……奇怪的癖好，而且你……还没完全{i}弄明白{/i}。

lines.en: : So what I’m hearing is you don’t love me.
lines.zh: : 那我听到的意思就是你不爱我。

lines.en: : Sana...you know that isn’t true. You {i}know{/i} that isn’t-
lines.zh: : Sana……你知道那不是真的。你{i}知道{/i}那不——

lines.en: : I {i}do{/i} know it isn’t true. It’s what I’m hearing, though. So what I don’t get is why you keep forcing yourself to say things neither one of us believes.
lines.zh: : 我{i}当然{/i}知道那不是真的。可我听到的就是这个。所以我不明白的是，你为什么还要逼自己说那些我们俩谁都不信的话。

lines.en: : Wouldn’t it be so much easier to just shut me up by going through with it? Even if it’s just once?
lines.zh: : 干脆做了它，让我闭嘴，不是轻松得多吗？哪怕就一次？

lines.en: : Because, if it’s as bad as you’re making it sound like it’ll be, maybe I’ll finally see things your way afterward and won’t ever ask you to do it again?
lines.zh: : 因为如果真像你说的那么糟，也许做完之后我终于能站到你这边，再也不会要你做了？

lines.en: : {i}Or...{/i}maybe we’ll both like it. And then all {i}three{/i} of us can be together as the family we’re meant to be. I know that’d make {i}me{/i} happy, Mom. But how about you?
